title: FormalEvolve: Neuro-Symbolic Evolutionary Search for Diverse Autoformalization
venue: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review - May 2026

parentSelection: Island-local weighted parent selection with usage penalty

mechanism.domainTask: Budgeted Lean autoformalization search for diverse semantically faithful theorem statements
mechanism.populationDetail: Two semi-isolated per-problem archives store unique compilation-feasible candidates; parent/context sampling is island-local with periodic migration.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite archive is described; the main archive stores all unique compilable candidates, while top-1 migration protection is a migration rule.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The feasible archive has configured capacity 40, but the capacity-eviction rule is not specified in the inspected description.
mechanism.generationDetail: Full patching broadly rewrites one parent while diff patching makes localized edits; cross patching adds one optional inspiration as context rather than a mandatory second parent.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Compilation is a hard gate; an LLM judge supplies a binary semantic-faithfulness label for compilable candidates.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The parent weight is a robustly normalized gate score passed through a sigmoid and multiplied by an inverse parent-use discount.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Compilation-gated archive search with bounded repair and generator-call-free symbolic AST diversification (EvolAST).
